title: Reflex and Reflexer: one question vocabulary, two engines
intro: Press play to walk the flow one step at a time, or click a dot to jump.

walk.title: One request shape
walk.text: Both engines speak the same wire: a state plus typed questions — choice, score, yes-no — and both answer in the same envelope. The captured request here is Reflex's, a yes-no question about a game state.

in.label: POST /decide — the shared wire
in.from: captured from the reflex 0.2.4 release binary, 2026-10-03 · POST /decide (answered request)

walk.title: 2a — the state is text
walk.text: Reflex's state is text you wrote: a sentence, a paragraph, a JSON object. The question engine reads it and answers from a corpus you author — or abstains.

walk.title: 3a — your corpus answers
walk.text: Answers come from documents, so off-corpus questions abstain honestly. This one the engine is sure on: outcome yes, calibrated confidence.

out.label: sure: outcome yes
out.from: captured from the reflex 0.2.4 release binary, 2026-10-03 · POST /decide (answered response)

walk.title: 2b — the state is a board
walk.text: Reflexer's state is the game facts: the board, the falling piece, what is left in the bag. The same wire, played as a game — this recorded turn comes from the arena's replay-verified rulebook walk.

in.label: a recorded game turn — board, piece, spot sentence
in.from: recorded rulebook game — the arena's replay-verified walk (recorded by the katgpt-rs site-walk example; turn 1)

walk.title: 3b — one frozen search
walk.text: The genome scores every board each legal move can lead to, and the best plan's first move is played. Same request, same answer, on every host — the pick here is the recorded one.

out.label: the recorded pick — argmax over the option scores
out.from: recorded rulebook game — the searched pick (argmax over the rulebook's option scores; turn 1, piece O)

walk.title: 4 — the shared envelope
walk.text: Both engines answer in the same shape: one typed answer per question with probabilities, or a first-class abstain. Your code does not change between them.

out.label: the envelope, Reflex side
out.from: captured from the reflex 0.2.4 release binary, 2026-10-03 · POST /decide (answered response)

walk.title: 5 — the vessel swaps the genome
walk.text: One signed file swaps the rulebook whole at boot — monotonically, never a weighted blend, because blends do not preserve move rankings. It is a public format: anyone can mint artifacts with it.
